453d5cd57f2c.speaker: ray
453d5cd57f2c.text: Quarter past midnight. The squad room is mine again.

429ec3f4868d.speaker: ray
429ec3f4868d.text: Danny Reyes. Two nights cold, and the lieutenant wants it closed by Friday.

1c61912ca76f.speaker: ray
1c61912ca76f.text: First, the file. I locked it away like a careful man.

5e348cced2a6.speaker: ray
5e348cced2a6.text: Then I hid the key like a paranoid one.
